projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Rust
description: Cargo crates. DeviceDetectionPipelineBuilder::cloud(key) or ::on_premise(path).auto_update(false).build()?, then pipeline.create_flow_data_with(Evidence::builder().add("header.user-agent", ua).build()), data.process()?, and data.get(DEVICE_DATA_KEY). IpIntelligencePipelineBuilder and IP_DATA_KEY cover IP Intelligence. Drop the on-premise feature to skip the C build. axum via fiftyone-pipeline-web-axum, 51Did via fodid and fodid-client. Install with cargo add fiftyone-device-detection
